contracts.name: Local app identity, revisions and portable source
contracts.compatibility: Read SQLite user_version 1, preserve completed source, and import portable project versions 1 through 3.
contracts.change_policy: Review migrations, interrupted writes, concurrent editing and file compatibility together.
contracts.rationale: Reopening an app must retain its identity and its completed features across restarts.
contracts.review_trigger: A new database version or change to library identity, revision or exchange semantics.

contracts.name: Progressive native projects and saved feature pages
contracts.compatibility: Preserve the root script, brief and feature ID to native page mapping. Keep version 1 and 2 readers.
contracts.change_policy: Review page persistence, stream assembly, SDK and runtime navigation together.
contracts.rationale: Published drawing scripts can request lazy features from user input and share app state.
contracts.review_trigger: A change to page navigation, shared state or generated project format.

contracts.name: Native drawing projects and drawing API
contracts.compatibility: Keep version 1 readable and preserve version 2 draw/input signatures and primitive arguments.
contracts.change_policy: Review the file format, generator instructions, native renderer and saved examples together.
contracts.rationale: Generated and manually authored drawing scripts use these interfaces.
contracts.review_trigger: A new drawing, input or browser operation.

contracts.name: Version 1 project files and browser capability
contracts.compatibility: Continue opening valid version 1 files with the documented defaults and browser commands.
contracts.change_policy: Review format, SDK, generator and stored project compatibility together.
verification: Run tests/test_project.py and tests/test_desktop.py using unittest discovery.
contracts.rationale: Generated apps refer to these names and users reopen their source across sessions.
contracts.review_trigger: A new project version or host capability.

entry_template.name: Example public boundary
entry_template.compatibility: Describe the behavior, schema, or API promise that must remain stable.
entry_template.change_policy: Explicit orchestrator approval, consumer impact review, migration plan, and verification are required.
entry_template.rationale: Explain why this boundary is frozen.
entry_template.review_trigger: Describe when this entry must be revisited.
